paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva: Berakhot 12b; Shabbat 108b, Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva several times [the checked text gives three teachings and calls him Rabbi]; Makkot 20b. Rav Yehudah arranged his son's marriage into Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva's household: Berakhot 42a. “Shmuel said”—Ketubot 60a. [The passage alternatively has him teaching the ruling before Shmuel.]
